svg.title: Complete video production ComfyUI workflow for all 114 CASOPS video agents
svg.desc: A top-to-bottom ComfyUI node graph covering intake, development and greenlight, pre-production, production, post-production, release review, distribution and archival, and post-release learning. All 114 video agents are shown once in their principal phase or in a cross-cutting orchestration, creative, research, optimization, and safety band. Parallel branches, quality gateways, human approval, targeted rework, correction loops, artifacts, and runtime status are identified.
svg.metadata: Synthesized from agents/video.*/SPEC.md and agent_spec.json, agents/video.orchestrator/sources/excerpts/agents.md, agents/video.worldbuilding/sources/excerpts/ai_agent_video_production_workflow.md, and agents/video.worldbuilding/sources/excerpts/ui_design.md. Principal placement is used for readability; many agents participate across phases. The multi-agent BPM is documented design intent. Current active agent runtimes are baseline-safe, local-deterministic, single-node DAGs with peer routing disabled.

g.text: Video Production · Complete Agent ComfyUI Workflow
All 114 CASOPS video agents · one ComfyUI node per agent · principal phase placement · governed artifact handoffs

STATUS NOTE — This is the documented multi-agent production design. Active agent runtimes remain baseline-safe, single-node local_deterministic DAGs with routing, peer hops, tools, and production activation disabled.

svg.text: Cross-cutting control, creative, research, optimization and safety services
Applied across every phase. These 28 agents shape, govern, measure, and remember work; craft and support agents own the phase deliverables.
USER + CONTROL PLANE · TEMPLATE A–J · SCALE S1–S7

g.text: A Viral · B UGC · C Explainer · D Personalized · E Short
F Training · G Music · H Avatar · I Documentary · J Feature
S1–S2 fast crew · S3–S4 premium · S5–S7 feature

Open human approval and escalation slots

svg.text: 16 PRINCIPAL AGENTS · DIVERGE IN PARALLEL → GREENLIGHT

g.text: Treatment / objectives · KPI targets · budget envelope · rights-risk register · scale profile

svg.text: 12 PRINCIPAL AGENTS · PARALLEL PACKAGE BUILD → L1 SPEC + HUMAN APPROVAL

g.text: Script lock · boards / lookbook · asset IDs · bibles · consent · continuity baseline

svg.text: 17 PRINCIPAL AGENTS · SCENES / SHOTS FAN OUT → PER-SHOT QC → L2 CRAFT GATE

g.text: Shot prompts · camera plans · performances · plates / takes · render telemetry

svg.text: 11 PRINCIPAL AGENTS · PICTURE / VISUAL / SOUND / ACCESSIBILITY LANES → REVIEWABLE MASTER

g.text: Timeline · graded master · stems · captions / subtitles · QC report · outlet variants

svg.text: 13 PRINCIPAL AGENTS · EVIDENCE + AUDIENCE + SAFETY + DOMAIN REVIEW → L3 / Q1–Q6 / HUMAN GATE

g.text: RELEASE PACK · L3 PREFERENCE + SIX-PASS DELIVERY MESH
Q1 spec · Q2 visual · Q3 audio/sync · Q4 continuity · Q5 perceptual · Q6 outlet readiness

svg.text: 14 PRINCIPAL AGENTS · CHANNELS FAN OUT IN PARALLEL · EACH BRANCH READY / PENDING / BLOCKED

g.text: Ready → publish · Pending → fix branch · Blocked → hold outlet

svg.text: Post-release observation, correction and continuous learning
3 PRINCIPAL AGENTS + CROSS-CUTTING RETENTION / ROAS / EVALUATION / MEMORY SERVICES

g.text: Failure patterns → prompt, routing, rubric or training ticket → regression → canary
ComfyUI node legend and operating notes

Coverage: cross-cutting 28 + development 16 + pre-production 12 + production 17 + post 11 + review 13 + distribution 14 + post-release 3 = 114. Principal placement avoids duplicate roster entries; roles may participate in multiple stages.
Sources: video agent SPECs / active agent_spec.json files; orchestrator roster; documented AI video workflow; project-stage UI design. Generated for repository workflow analysis.
